quotes.quote: Yesterday is history, tomorrow is a mystery, today is a gift of God, which is why we call it the present.
quotes.author: Bil Keane

quotes.quote: To be able to look back upon one's past life with satisfaction is to live twice.
quotes.author: Lord Acton

quotes.quote: I'm involved in quite a few ministries as a bridge builder, trying to match generous givers and donors to other ministries. Based on my past, I'm also involved in mainly the prison ministry. I go to jails and prisons and share my story, trying to give them some hope.
quotes.author: Lex Luger

quotes.quote: Remember, if the time should come when you have to make a choice between what is right and what is easy, remember what happened to a boy who was good, and kind, and brave, because he strayed across the path of Lord Voldemort. Remember Cedric Diggory.
quotes.author: J.K. Rowling,  Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire

quotes.quote: During my life I have seen, known, and lost too much to be the prey of vain dread; and, as for the hope of immortality, I am as weary of that as I am of gods and kings. For my own sake only I write this; and herein I differ from all other writers, past and to come.
quotes.author: Mika Waltari

quotes.quote: With the past, I have nothing to do; nor with the future. I live now.
quotes.author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

quotes.quote: Past performance speaks a tremendous amount about one's ability and likelihood for success.
quotes.author: Mark Spitz

quotes.quote: If ever there is tomorrow when we're not together... there is something you must always remember. You are braver than you believe, stronger than you seem, and smarter than you think. But the most important thing is, even if we're apart... I'll always be with you.
quotes.author: A.A. Milne

quotes.quote: When you put something out there into the world, there's all these words you don't want to hear, that you hope people don't say. I don't like anything that starts with 're' - like retro, reinvent, recreate - I hate that. It's always like living in the past - copying, emulating.
quotes.author: Jack White

quotes.quote: I wanted to write a very simple story about a boy, a wolf, a girl, a bear and a forest, so I thought I might set it in the past. I didn't realise that it went back to when I was 10: I used to love the Stone Age when I was a kid and wanted to live in it, and I got rid of my bed and slept on the floor, but I didn't remember it.
quotes.author: Michelle Paver

quotes.quote: Jazz music is America's past and its potential, summed up and sanctified and accessible to anybody who learns to listen to, feel, and understand it. The music can connect us to our earlier selves and to our better selves-to-come. It can remind us of where we fit on the time line of human achievement, an ultimate value of art.
quotes.author: Wynton Marsalis

quotes.quote: Every saint has a past, and every sinner has a future.
quotes.author: Oscar Wilde

quotes.quote: Sometimes you climb out of bed in the morning and you think, I'm not going to make it, but you laugh inside -- remembering all the times you've felt that way.
quotes.author: Charles Bukowski

quotes.quote: I used to be really cute. I could send you earlier photos where I'm stunning. But I've gained about twenty pounds over the past two years, and the more weight I've put on, the more success I've had. If you drew a diagram of weight gain and me getting more work, a mathematician would draw some conclusions from that.
quotes.author: Zach Galifianakis

quotes.quote: Nothing that's worthwhile is ever easy. Remember that.
quotes.author: Nicholas Sparks,  Message in a Bottle

quotes.quote: Remember when you tried to convince me to feed a poultry pie to the mallards in the park to see if you could breed a race of cannibal ducks?""They ate it too,"Will reminisced. "Bloodthirsty little beasts. Never trust a duck.
quotes.author: Cassandra Clare,  Clockwork Angel

quotes.quote: What matters in life is not what happens to you but what you remember and how you remember it.
quotes.author: Gabriel GarcÃ­Â­a MÃ¡rquez

quotes.quote: Some things don't last forever, but some things do. Like a good song, or a good book, or a good memory you can take out and unfold in your darkest times, pressing down on the corners and peering in close, hoping you still recognize the person you see there.
quotes.author: Sarah Dessen,  This Lullaby

quotes.quote: Over the past few years, the road to confrontation has shown its consequences: loss of innocent lives, destruction and fear. Most costly, however, was the loss of hope. The most precious gift that you can present to your peoples over the coming weeks is renewed hope born out of tangible progress on the ground.
quotes.author: Abdallah II of Jordan

quotes.quote: I believe the universe wants to be noticed. I think the universe is inprobably biased toward the consciousness, that it rewards intelligence in part because the universe enjoys its elegance being observed. And who am I, living in the middle of history, to tell the universe that it-or my observation of it-is temporary?
quotes.author: John Green,  The Fault in Our Stars

quotes.quote: Death must be so beautiful. To lie in the soft brown earth, with the grasses waving above one's head, and listen to silence. To have no yesterday, and no tomorrow. To forget time, to forgive life, to be at peace.
quotes.author: Oscar Wilde,  The Canterville Ghost

quotes.quote: Art is for anyone. It just isn't for everyone. Still, over the past decade, its audience has hugely grown, and that's irked those outside the art world, who get irritated at things like incomprehensibility or money.
quotes.author: Jerry Saltz

quotes.quote: We have a hope of succeeding if we learn from our past mistakes and pull together to make the hard choices.
quotes.author: Carl Levin

quotes.quote: You don't remember what happened. What you remember becomes what happened.
quotes.author: John Green,  An Abundance of Katherines

quotes.quote: The past explains how I got here, but the future is up to me - and I love to live life at full throttle.
quotes.author: Janice Dickinson

quotes.quote: Education is an admirable thing, but it is well to remember from time to time that nothing that is worth knowing can be taught.
quotes.author: Oscar Wilde

quotes.quote: All grown-ups were once children... but only few of them remember it.
quotes.author: Antoine de Saint-ExupÃ©ry,  The Little Prince

quotes.quote: You realize that our mistrust of the future makes it hard to give up the past.
quotes.author: Chuck Palahniuk,  Survivor

quotes.quote: You think your pain and your heartbreak are unprecedented in the history of the world, but then you read.
quotes.author: James Baldwin

quotes.quote: Keep in mind that people change, but the past doesn't.
quotes.author: Becca Fitzpatrick,  Hush, Hush

quotes.quote: There's things that happen in a person's life that are so scorched in the memory and burned into the heart that there's no forgetting them.
quotes.author: John Boyne

quotes.quote: Did you ever think that in a past life Alec was an old woman with ninety cats who was always yelling at the neighborhood kids to get off her lawn? Because I do,
quotes.author: Cassandra Clare,  City of Glass

quotes.quote: Every time you are tempted to react in the same old way, ask if you want to be a prisoner of the past or a pioneer of the future.
quotes.author: Deepak Chopra

quotes.quote: Remember if people talk behind your back, it only means you are two steps ahead.
quotes.author: Fannie Flagg,  Fried Green Tomatoes at the Whistle Stop Cafe

quotes.quote: The pleasure of remembering had been taken from me, because there was no longer anyone to remember with. It felt like losing your co-rememberer meant losing the memory itself, as if the things we'd done were less real and important than they had been hours before.
quotes.author: John Green,  The Fault in Our Stars

quotes.quote: Yesterday is gone. Tomorrow has not yet come. We have only today. Let us begin.
quotes.author: Mother Teresa

quotes.quote: The best portion of a good man's life: his little, nameless unremembered acts of kindness and love.
quotes.author: William Wordsworth,  Lyrical Ballads

quotes.quote: Sometimes, I feel the past and the future pressing so hard on either side that there's no room for the present at all.
quotes.author: Evelyn Waugh,  Brideshead Revisited

quotes.quote: Remembering that you are going to die is the best way I know to avoid the trap of thinking you have something to lose. You are already naked. There is no reason not to follow your heart.
quotes.author: Steve Jobs

quotes.quote: Forbidden to remember, terrified to forget; it was a hard line to walk.
quotes.author: Stephenie Meyer,  New Moon

quotes.quote: Our memory is a more perfect world than the universe: it gives back life to those who no longer exist.
quotes.author: Guy de Maupassant

quotes.quote: Remember me and smile, for it's better to forget than to remember me and cry.
quotes.author: Dr. Seuss

quotes.quote: In a basic sense, 'A Little Life' is a homage to how my friends and I live our lives. I wanted to push past the definitions of how we typically define friendship. It's a different version of adulthood, but it's no less important and no less legitimate than anyone else's.
quotes.author: Hanya Yanagihara

quotes.quote: When we are tired, we are attacked by ideas we conquered long ago.
quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche

quotes.quote: Happiness is something that comes into our lives through doors we don't even remember leaving open.
quotes.author: Rose Wilder Lane

quotes.quote: History does not always repeat itself. Sometimes it just yells, 'Can't you remember anything I told you?' and lets fly with a club.
quotes.author: John W. Campbell Jr.

quotes.quote: If you don't know history, then you don't know anything. You are a leaf that doesn't know it is part of a tree.
quotes.author: Michael Crichton

quotes.quote: The past is never where you think you left it.
quotes.author: Katherine Anne Porter

quotes.quote: I'm not going to get somewhere and say, 'OK, I'm done.' Success is never final; I'll just keep on going. The same way as failure never being fatal. Just keep going. I'm going to the stars and then past them.
quotes.author: Conor McGregor

quotes.quote: The past is always tense, the future perfect.
quotes.author: Zadie Smith

quotes.quote: You will hear thunder and remember me,and think: she wanted storms...
quotes.author: Anna Akhmatova

quotes.quote: But until a person can say deeply and honestly, "I am what I am today because of the choices I made yesterday,"that person cannot say, "I choose otherwise.
quotes.author: Stephen R. Covey,  The 7 Habits of Highly Effective People: Powerful Lessons in Personal Change

quotes.quote: Because this is what happens when you try to run from the past. It just doesn't catch up, it overtakes ... blotting out the future.
quotes.author: Sarah Dessen,  Just Listen

quotes.quote: Books are easily destroyed. But words will live as long as people can remember them.
quotes.author: Tahereh Mafi,  Unravel Me

quotes.quote: Dress shabbily and they remember the dress; dress impeccably and they remember the woman.
quotes.author: Coco Chanel

quotes.quote: The present changes the past. Looking back you do not find what you left behind.
quotes.author: Kiran Desai,  The Inheritance of Loss

quotes.quote: Whenever you feel like criticizing any one...just remember that all the people in this world haven't had the advantages that you've had.
quotes.author: F. Scott Fitzgerald

quotes.quote: If you live through the initial stage of fame and get past it, and remember thats not who you are. If you live past that, then you have a hope of maybe learning how to spell the word artist.
quotes.author: Patrick Swayze

quotes.quote: Our lives are not our own. We are bound to others, past and present, and by each crime and every kindness, we birth our future.
quotes.author: David Mitchell,  Cloud Atlas

quotes.quote: Between memory and reality there are awkward discrepancies...
quotes.author: Eileen Chang

quotes.quote: The past beats inside me like a second heart.
quotes.author: John Banville,  The Sea

quotes.quote: Is it fair to have given us the memory of what was and the desire of what could be when we must suffer what is?
quotes.author: Neil Jordan,  The Dream of a Beast

quotes.quote: You forget what you want to remember, and you remember what you want to forget.
quotes.author: Cormac McCarthy,  The Road

quotes.quote: You are not Atlas carrying the world on your shoulder. It is good to remember that the planet is carrying you.
quotes.author: Vandana Shiva

quotes.quote: The leaders who we admire who have been able to bring great change in the past - Gandhi, Martin Luther King, Nelson Mandela - they're all inspirational religious leaders and smart tacticians. It would be nice to find the Muslim Gandhi, wouldn't it?
quotes.author: Dennis C. Blair

quotes.quote: We just want to win. That's the bottom line. I think a lot of times people may become content with one championship or a little bit of success, but we don't really reflect on what we've done in the past. We focus on the present.
quotes.author: Derek Jeter

quotes.quote: Life is divided into three terms - that which was, which is, and which will be. Let us learn from the past to profit by the present, and from the present, to live better in the future.
quotes.author: William Wordsworth

quotes.quote: Faith is not simply a patience that passively suffers until the storm is past. Rather, it is a spirit that bears things - with resignations, yes, but above all, with blazing, serene hope.
quotes.author: Corazon Aquino

quotes.quote: You spend your whole life stuck in the labyrinth, thinking about how you'll escape one day, and how awesome it will be, and imagining that future keeps you going, but you never do it. You just use the future to escape the present.
quotes.author: John Green,  Looking for Alaska

quotes.quote: We are products of our past, but we don't have to be prisoners of it.
quotes.author: Rick Warren,  The Purpose Driven Life: What on Earth Am I Here for?

quotes.quote: It is by no means an irrational fancy that, in a future existence, we shall look upon what we think our present existence, as a dream.
quotes.author: Edgar Allan Poe

quotes.quote: We have been so successful in the past century at the art of living longer and staying alive that we have forgotten how to die. Too often we learn the hard way. As soon as the baby boomers pass pensionable age, their lesson will be harsher still.
quotes.author: Terry Pratchett

quotes.quote: You're just another story I can't tell anymore.
quotes.author: pleasefindthis,  I Wrote This For You

quotes.quote: Going by my past journey, I am not certain where life will take me, what turns and twists will happen; nobody knows where they will end up. As life changes direction, I'll flow with it.
quotes.author: Katrina Kaif

quotes.quote: I loved you so much once. I did. More than anything in the whole wide world. Imagine that. What a laugh that is now. Can you believe it? We were so intimate once upon a time I can't believe it now. The memory of being that intimate with somebody. We were so intimate I could puke. I can't imagine ever being that intimate with somebody else. I haven't been.
quotes.author: Raymond Carver,  Where I'm Calling From: New and Selected Stories

quotes.quote: We leave something of ourselves behind when we leave a place, we stay there, even though we go away. And there are things in us that we can find again only by going back there.
quotes.author: Pascal Mercier,  Night Train to Lisbon

quotes.quote: My past has not defined me, destroyed me, deterred me, or defeated me; it has only strengthened me.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

quotes.quote: It has shown me that everything is illuminated in the light of the past. It is always along the side of us...on the inside, looking out.
quotes.author: Jonathan Safran Foer

quotes.quote: Frustration and Love can't exist in the same place at the same time, so get real and start doing what you would rather be doing in life. Love your life. All of it. Even the heavy shit that happened to you when you were 8. All of it was and IS perfect.
quotes.author: Jason Mraz

quotes.quote: True regret is knowing you missed your only opportunity to be simply a good friend to someone that was exactly like you.
quotes.author: Shannon L. Alder

quotes.quote: Her and I, we passed each other, and now she's in my past. That's one present I'd like to unwrap in the future.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: My ex-girlfriend was exquisite, while my current girlfriend is merely quisite. The ex always makes the past seem more excellent than the present.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: Without libraries what have we? We have no past and no future.
quotes.author: Ray Bradbury

quotes.quote: You couldn't erase the past. You couldn't even change it. But sometimes life offered you the opportunity to put it right.
quotes.author: Ann Brashares,  Girls In Pants: The Third Summer of the Sisterhood

quotes.quote: I can't. You can't rewrite the past.
quotes.author: Jay Asher,  Thirteen Reasons Why

quotes.quote: I held her gaze as I held her in my arms. With all that holding I couldn't hold on to the moment, and it slipped past me into the lonely past.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: To me, Green Arrow in the past, what people loved about Oliver Queen pre-New 52 was his relationships with other heroes. Like his friendship with Green Lantern, his animosity with Hawkman, his romance with Black Canary - these are all the things that sort of defined him.
quotes.author: Jeff Lemire

quotes.quote: Its more fun to think of the future than dwell on the past.
quotes.author: Sara Shepard,  Unbelievable

quotes.quote: The past is made out of facts... I guess the future is just hope.
quotes.author: Isaac Marion,  Warm Bodies

quotes.quote: How many people long for that "past, simpler, and better world,"I wonder, without ever recognizing the truth that perhaps it was they who were simpler and better, and not the world about them?
quotes.author: R.A. Salvatore,  Streams of Silver

quotes.quote: You are always free to change your mind and choose a different future, or a different past.
quotes.author: Richard Bach

quotes.quote: I just don't see why the past has to matter.
quotes.author: Cassandra Clare,  City of Fallen Angels

quotes.quote: I see two women, one in a reflection in a window, and the other I see through the window, and it's like I'm looking at both my past and future at the same time.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: I have a Rubik's Cube for a rearview mirror, because the past is the only time puzzle I can solve. My love for her only looks clear there.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: She's twelve hours in the future, and exactly half a world away. No matter how hard I try, I will always be a part of her past.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: My past is black and my future is blank. My only canvas is the present. The best color to paint with is love.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: The past can teach us, nurture us, but it cannot sustain us. The essence of life is change, and we must move ever forward or the soul will wither and die.
quotes.author: Susanna Kearsley,  Mariana

quotes.quote: The only thing new in the world is the history you do not know.
quotes.author: Harry S. Truman

quotes.quote: Whoever said that the past isn't dead had it backward. It's the future that's already dead, already played out.
quotes.author: Gayle Forman,  Where She Went

quotes.quote: When I lost her I gained the future, because she was my past, and she freed me to become who I was born to be.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: The sunset sky fades from blue to orange over Gainesville, Florida, and what I lost is less than what I gained. I gained love, I lost love, and if could do it all again, I would.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: People who say that yesterday was better than today are ultimately devaluing their own existence.
quotes.author: Karl Lagerfeld

quotes.quote: Me and you, we got more yesterday than anybody. We need some kind of tomorrow.
quotes.author: Toni Morrison,  Beloved

quotes.quote: â€ŽNo people whose word for 'yesterday' is the same as their word for 'tomorrow' can be said to have a firm grip on the time.
quotes.author: Salman Rushdie,  Midnight's Children

quotes.quote: Every time a student walks past a really urgent, expressive piece of architecture that belongs to his college, it can help reassure him that he does have that mind, does have that soul.
quotes.author: Louis Kahn

quotes.quote: I wanted the past to go away, I wanted to leave it, like another country; I wanted my life to close, and open like a hinge, like a wing, like the part of the song where it falls down over the rocks: an explosion, a discovery; I wanted to hurry into the work of my life; I wanted to know,whoever I was, I wasalive for a little while.
quotes.author: Mary Oliver,  Dream Work

quotes.quote: To design the future effectively, you must first let go of your past.
quotes.author: Charles J. Givens

quotes.quote: Some people read palms to tell your future, but I read hands to tell your past. Each scar makes a story worth telling. Each callused palm, each cracked knuckle is a missed punch or years in a factory.
quotes.author: Sarah Kay

quotes.quote: The only real battle in life is between hanging on and letting go.
quotes.author: Shannon L. Alder

quotes.quote: The past attracts me, the present frightens me, because the future is death.
quotes.author: Guy de Maupassant,  The Complete Short Stories of Guy de Maupassant, Part One

quotes.quote: As the future ripens in the past,so the past rots in the future --a terrible festival of dead leaves.
quotes.author: Anna Akhmatova,  Poems of Akhmatova

quotes.quote: Regret is counterproductive. It's looking back on a past that you can't change. Questioning things as they occur can prevent regret in the future.
quotes.author: Colleen Hoover,  Slammed

quotes.quote: The scent of Florida honeysuckle uplifted in a spring breeze reminds me of your love, and how fresh it was until it blew past me into my past.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: No heirloom of humankind captures the past as do art and language.
quotes.author: Theodore Bikel

quotes.quote: Who we were and who we are are four different people, and the me from now doesn't relate to the me from then, let alone to the you from now.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: All sins are forgiven once you start making a lot of money.
quotes.author: RuPaul

quotes.quote: If you want to fly on the sky, you need to leave the earth. If you want to move forward, you need to let go the past that drags you down.
quotes.author: Amit Ray,  World Peace: The Voice of a Mountain Bird

quotes.quote: In the end, your past is not my past and your truth is not my truth and your solution - is not my solution.
quotes.author: Zadie Smith,  White Teeth

quotes.quote: What was the point of trying to run away if people were going to insist on reminding you of what you were running from?
quotes.author: Morgan Matson,  Second Chance Summer

quotes.quote: I hide how I feel, and I hide the fact that I hide how I feel, but I can't bury the past without having a funeral of the heart.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: Let today be the day you finally release yourself from the imprisonment of past grudges and anger. Simplify your life. Let go of the poisonous past and live the abundantly beautiful present... today.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

quotes.quote: that there are many things that we cant understand. the past. the bad things that happened... and we become afraid. of what might happen in the future. its okay to be afraid. but we have to keep hoping and believeing... to keep hoping and trying our best to be good and do good. even when we're afraid
quotes.author: Nafisa Haji,  The Writing on My Forehead

quotes.quote: I look out into the water and up deep into the stars. I beg the sparkling lanterns of light to cure me of myself -- my past and the kaleidoscope of mistakes, failures and wrong turns that have stacked unbearable regret upon my shoulders.
quotes.author: Jennifer Elisabeth,  Born Ready: Unleash Your Inner Dream Girl

quotes.quote: The Gospel offers forgiveness for the past, new life for the present, and hope for the future.
quotes.author: John Sentamu

quotes.quote: I fell for you like the stars fall from the sky. Flames and light and twinkle dust, our burning love showered the night. The dust has been collecting since the day you left, and I dare not leave even one fingerprint in it, because one should never try to touch the past.-Crystal Woods and Jarod Kintz
quotes.author: Crystal Woods,  liQUID PROse QUOtes

quotes.quote: Man...who lives in three places - in the past, in the present, and in the future - can be unhappy if one of these three is worthless. Religion has even added a fourth - eternity.
quotes.author: Georg Christoph Lichtenberg

quotes.quote: Witness also that when we talk about literature, we do so in the present tense. When we speak of the dead, we are not so kind.
quotes.author: John Green,  The Fault in Our Stars

quotes.quote: He believed in himself, believed in his quixotic ambition, letting the failures of the previous day disappear as each new day dawned. Yesterday was not today. The past did not predict the future if he could learn from his mistakes.
quotes.author: Daniel Wallace,  The Kings and Queens of Roam

quotes.quote: There is no future without a past, because what is to be cannot be imagined except as a form of repetition.
quotes.author: Siri Hustvedt,  The Summer Without Men

quotes.quote: People don't get to our ages without having pasts. I'm more interested in the future.
quotes.author: Robyn Donald,  Tiger, Tiger

quotes.quote: Fair as the moon and joyful as the light;Tot wan with waiting, not with sorrow dim; Not as she is, but was when hope shone bright;Not as she is, but as she fills his dreams.
quotes.author: Christina Rossetti

quotes.quote: I met a boy whose eyes showed me that the past, present and future were all the same thing.
quotes.author: Jennifer Elisabeth

quotes.quote: After his experience with Minos, Nico realized that most spectres held only as much power as you allowed them to have. They pried into your mind, using fear or anger or longing to influence you. Nico had learned to shield himself. Sometimes he could even turn the tables and bend ghosts to his will.
quotes.author: Rick Riordan,  The Blood of Olympus

quotes.quote: Forgiveness isn't something I'm preoccupied with -- turning the other cheek isn't my trip.
quotes.author: Karl Lagerfeld

quotes.quote: Faith is about going through hell, coming out with some scars, and becoming a wiser person from the lessons you've learned along the way. You must take the scars of your past and appreciate them for what they have taught you. You also have to take the scars, the lessons of your past and not let them control your future....
quotes.author: James A. Murphy,  The Waves of Life Quotes and Daily Meditations

quotes.quote: I wanted the past to go away, I wantedto leave it, like another country; I wantedmy life to close, and openlike a hinge, like a wing, like the part of the songwhere it fallsdown over the rocks: an explosion, a discovery;I wantedto hurry into the work of my life; I wanted to know,whoever I was, I wasalivefor a little while.
quotes.author: Mary Oliver,  Dream Work

quotes.quote: My best day ever. Got up. Had breakfast. Came to school. Bored, as usual. Wishing I wasn't there, like usual. Kids ignoring me, suits me fine. Sitting with the other retards--we're so special. Wasting my time. Yesterday was the same, and it's gone, anyway. Tomorrow may never come. There is only today. This is the best day and the worst day. Actually it's crap.
quotes.author: Rachel Ward,  Numbers

quotes.quote: The choices we're working with here are a block universe, where past, present and future all coexist simultaneously and everything has already happened; chaos, where anything can happen and nothing can be predicted because we can't know all the variables; and a Christian universe in which God made everything and it's all here for a purpose but we have free will anyway.
quotes.author: Audrey Niffenegger,  The Time Traveler's Wife

quotes.quote: We have to know the truth about the past to discover out future.
quotes.author: Patti Callahan Henry,  Between the Tides

quotes.quote: Into my heart an air that killsFrom yon far country blows:What are those blue remembered hills,What spires, what farms are those?That is the land of lost content,I see it shining plain,The happy highways where I wentAnd cannot come again.
quotes.author: A.E. Housman,  A Shropshire Lad

quotes.quote: You can't be a rebel without the scars that come with it. Truth is, some days scars are just as ugly as they are beautiful.
quotes.author: Criss Jami,  Killosophy

quotes.quote: It is not as much about who you used to be, as it is about who you choose to be.
quotes.author: Sanhita Baruah

quotes.quote: What comes, when it comes, will be what it is.
quotes.author: Alberto Caeiro,  The Collected Poems of Alberto Caeiro

quotes.quote: THE FOUR HEAVENLY FOUNTAINSLaugh, I tell youAnd you will turn backThe hands of time.Smile, I tell youAnd you will reflectThe face of the divine.Sing, I tell youAnd all the angels will sing with you!Cry, I tell youAnd the reflections found in your pool of tears -Will remind you of the lessons of today and yesterdayTo guide you through the fears of tomorrow.
quotes.author: Suzy Kassem,  Rise Up and Salute the Sun: The Writings of Suzy Kassem

quotes.quote: The ability to withstand the flinch comes with the knowledge that the future will be better than the past.
quotes.author: Julien Smith,  The Flinch

quotes.quote: Past and future is determined by what is now...right now! This is why the present is a gift; the only one that ultimately matters most.
quotes.author: T.F. Hodge,  From Within I Rise: Spiritual Triumph Over Death and Conscious Encounters with "The Divine Presence"

quotes.quote: We may be living past and future lives at the same time we are living this one.
quotes.author: Doug Dillon

quotes.quote: You will never get everything in life but you will get enough.
quotes.author: Sanhita Baruah

quotes.quote: Past and Present I know well; each is a friend and sometimes an enemy to me. But it is the quiet, beckoning Future, an absolute stranger, with whom I have fallen madly in love.
quotes.author: Richelle E. Goodrich

quotes.quote: Many of our problems are broadly similar to those that undermined ... Norse Greenland, and that many other past societies also struggled to solve. Some of those past societies failed (like the Greenland Norse) and others succeeded ... The past offers us a rich database from which we can learn in order that we may keep on succeeding.
quotes.author: Jared Diamond,  Collapse: How Societies Choose to Fail or Succeed

quotes.quote: We can accept and embrace our pasts as part of the path that shaped who we are now.
quotes.author: Amy Leigh Mercree,  The Spiritual Girl's Guide to Dating: Your Enlightened Path to Love, Sex, & Soul Mates

quotes.quote: but her mind feels feverish as it races through the crowded hallways of the past
quotes.author: Thrity Umrigar,  The Space Between Us

quotes.quote: I shall not dwell in the past...I shall not dread the present...I shall not fear the Future...For as Long as I live...I shall only think of success.
quotes.author: Oscar Trejo Jr.,  Remember Me Tomorrow

quotes.quote: Sometimes you wish the world would be a better place and sometimes you wish the world was a better place. Only the great understanding of the difference of the time between the past and present moment will make it a better place.
quotes.author: Jammy Creamer

quotes.quote: Past, I am letting you go. Future, I will see you tomorrow. Present, I love you, live in you, celebrate you, and will never let you go.
quotes.author: Debasish Mridha

quotes.quote: At the end of almost every AA meeting, someone read the Promises. One of these was 'We will not regret the past nor wish to shut the door on it'. Dan thought he would always regret the past, but he had quit trying to shut the door. Why bother, when it would just come open again? The fucking had no latch, let alone a lock.
quotes.author: Stephen King,  Doctor Sleep

quotes.quote: Because that was then and this is now. Because the past is gone, even though it defines the present.
quotes.author: Stephen King,  Doctor Sleep

quotes.quote: My heart was in my mouth. I realised that I had no desire to know any more about her past. What was behind her made me feel sick, petrified. Only the future mattered now.
quotes.author: Ruth Ahmed,  When Ali Met Honour

quotes.quote: A wise man never dwells in the past because he knows he belongs to the future.
quotes.author: Debasish Mridha

quotes.quote: We can never live in the past; so everyday we begin anew.
quotes.author: Debasish Mridha

quotes.quote: Think of tomorrow, the past can't be mended.
quotes.author: Confucius
